title: Heat on a code map
description: A toy map of seven code files: click a file to add heat, and each step moves a share of it along the import links (faster against the arrows than with them) and keeps a fraction T of the total.

changes: line 7: <script src="https://d3js.org/d3.v7.min.js"></script> -> <link rel="manifest" href="manifest.webmanifest"> followed by <script src="vendor/d3.v7.min.js"></script> (vendored d3 v7.9.0, sha256:f2094bbf6141b359722c4fe454eb6c4b0f0e42cc10cc7af921fc158fceb86539, at apps/ast_diffusion/vendor/d3.v7.min.js)
end of body, before </script>: added a service worker registration block (navigator.serviceWorker.register('sw.js')) so the standalone page is installable on its own, not only through the hub shell

kit restyle: linked src/panel/tokens.css in <head>; every hardcoded hex in the <style> block and inline spans/buttons now reads a kit custom property (--bg/--panel/--line/--fg/--dim/--faint/--accent/--alert/--mono/--sans/--radius-1); page ground moved from #fafafa to the kit's graphite --bg (#050505)

decay fix: the Step Convolution handler's alpha/beta message-passing (around the 'Convolution (Message Passing)' comment) added each cascaded flow to its destination without ever subtracting it from its origin, so total field heat grew without bound every step regardless of the decay/evaporation param — decay was applied but structurally overwhelmed by this non-conservative duplication; fixed by subtracting each computed flow from its origin node's nextHeat alongside the existing addition to its destination, so decay is now the field's only source of dissipation and total heat provably shrinks (geometrically, at the decay ratio) once deposits stop

data color map: colorScale swapped from d3.interpolateYlOrRd to d3.interpolateHcl('#fff3b0', '#ff5a36') over the same [0,5] domain — the stock ramp's high end (~rgb(128,0,38), ~1.9:1 contrast against the new --bg) nearly disappeared into the dark ground; the replacement keeps the same warm 'heat' hue family (still a perceptually honest sequential magnitude map, never the chrome --accent/--ok/--warn/--alert) but stays legible (>6:1 contrast at the domain's hot end) across the full range on dark

sw.js: CACHE_NAME bumped from ast-diffusion-v1 to ast-diffusion-v2 so the cache-first service worker's activate handler evicts the stale-cached pre-restyle index.html for anyone who has already installed this app, instead of serving it forever

outflow cap (issue #37): the conservative cascade computed every alpha/beta flow from pre-step heat and subtracted it from the decayed value (heat*decay), then clamped the result at 0 in the commit step. A node with an in-link sends alpha*heat in total and a node with an out-link sends beta*heat, so whenever alpha+beta exceeded decay the node was overdrawn, the clamp discarded the negative balance, and the flows it had already delivered became new heat (real page, router.ts seeded with 5, alpha=beta=1, decay=0.5: total 5 -> 10 -> 15 -> 30 -> 43.1 -> 86.3 -> 123.0 in 6 steps; 6190 of 9702 swept slider settings created heat). Fixed in the Step Convolution handler: step 1 now also computes a per-node outScale = decay / (alpha[if inDegree>0] + beta[if outDegree>0]) when that sum exceeds decay, else exactly 1, and both flow expressions are multiplied by outScale of their origin node. Total outflow can therefore never exceed the node's decayed heat, the clamp never fires on a negative balance, and total heat after a step is exactly decay * total before (0 of 9702 settings create heat; worst per-step excess 1e-14, float rounding). At the default sliders (0.6/0.1/0.9) and at any setting with alpha+beta <= decay the scale is exactly 1, so those trajectories are bit-identical to before (router.ts 5 -> 2.657205 in 6 steps, unchanged).

sw.js: CACHE_NAME bumped from ast-diffusion-v2 to ast-diffusion-v3 alongside the issue #37 outflow cap, so the cache-first service worker evicts the pre-fix index.html for returning visitors instead of serving the heat-creating version indefinitely (entry file unchanged by this edit; entryHash unaffected)

honest relabel + readout (2026-09-24 correctness pass): (1) colorScale gets .clamp(true); the HCL ramp over [0,5] extrapolated past its end, so a file holding 50 heat rendered rgb(0,0,155) (blue) and after the fix renders rgb(255,90,54), the hot end. (2) New 'Total heat' numeric readout (sum over files, updated on every click/Step/Clear) and a per-file hover title with its heat. (3) Retitled 'AST Topological Convolution Kernel' / 'Topological AST Diffusion' -> 'Heat on a code map': the graph is an import graph, not an abstract syntax tree, and the step is thresholded asymmetric mass transfer, not a convolution; intro, slider labels and buttons reworded per the wording audit (Step Convolution (t+1) -> Step, Clear All Heat -> Clear heat). (4) Added a note under 'heat kept per step' saying when sends are scaled down and that total heat ends each step at exactly T times its value. (5) Added a cogdoc+yaml block declaring alpha, beta, T, the 0.05 send threshold, outScale and the conservation condition. (6) The Step and Clear handlers became named functions step()/clearHeat() bound to the same buttons, and a test port window.__ast {nodes, params, step, clear, total, deposit} exposes them; the step arithmetic is unchanged. Evidence on the real page: over the full slider grid (alpha, beta 0..1 by 0.05, T 0.5..1 by 0.05, 5 heat on each file in turn, 6 steps; 203,742 steps) max |after/before - T| = 5.6e-16 and 0 steps increased total heat. The earlier entry's wording 'total heat provably shrinks (geometrically, at the decay ratio)' held only when alpha+beta <= T until the issue #37 cap; the condition that holds now is: total after a step = T x total before, for all slider settings. The earlier 'stays legible across the full range' held only on [0,5]; it now holds everywhere because of the clamp.
